summary_points: Document title: Heat Transfer Oil to Molten Salts Heat Exchanger - User’s Design Specification
Client: Arizona Solar One LLC
Project: Solana Generation Station
Revision: 0, Initial Issue Date: 09-03-2017
ASME Code, Section VIII, Div 2, Ed. 2017, Class 2 is the primary reference standard
Specification covers design and construction of 6 horizontal BFU type Heat Transfer Oil to Salt Heat Exchangers
Additional requirements include non-destructive examination, restricted chemistry, heat treatments, and more
The document is for the design specification of an oil to molten salt heat exchanger.
It includes installation site details, environmental conditions (wind and earthquake loads), and operating conditions.
The vessels are designed for horizontal orientation with TEMA type BFU and specific dimensions.
Design pressures, temperatures, and live loads are specified according to ASME standards.
Fatigue analysis required due to metal temperature variations.
Materials specified include SA 533, Gr.B, Cl.2 for cylindrical shell and heads.
Nozzles require non-destructive examination as per ASME V.
Overpressure protection provided by others, discharge on atmosphere at safe place.
Neck flanges exposed edges and manholes should be rounded to the vessel inner surface.
Welders and welds qualification must comply with ASME IX & ASME VIII Division 2.
Body joints shall be full penetration, butt weld; consumable inserts or backing plates are not allowed.
Nozzles and fittings must be welded with full penetration unless otherwise indicated by the customer.
Water is used as fluid for Hydrostatic Test; other means require approval.
Additional welds are not allowed after Hydrostatic Test completion.
Manufacturer’s design report must be certified by a Registered Professional or Professional Engineer.
Certificate of Compliance confirms adherence to ASME Section VIII, Division 2 Pressure Vessel Code.
